stories.title: Series Preview — Cubs vs Brewers 4-Game at Wrigley
stories.angle: is_series_start_today=true, reserved 7:00 AM slot. Cubs begin 4-game home series vs Milwaukee Brewers (85-52, NL-best). Cubs 77-60, trail by 7.5 with 26 left. First pitch 6:40 PM CT tonight. Holmes vs Harrison. 7 of Cubs' next 10 against Milwaukee — season-defining stretch.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Cubs vs. Brewers. 4 games. Wrigley Field. First pitch 6:40 PM CT.

Milwaukee is 85-52. The best record in baseball. Chicago trails by 7.5 with 26 left.

Clay Holmes vs. Kyle Harrison tonight. Seven of the Cubs' next 10 are against Milwaukee.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Reds Series Recap — Cubs Finish 1-2, Now Face Milwaukee
stories.angle: Cubs went 1-2 against a 63-71 Reds team. Game 3 loss: Reds 7-5 (Aug 30). Hector Rodriguez's 3-run HR in 4th inning erased 2-0 Cubs lead. Chase Burns 5.2 IP, 7 K. Cubs are 3-7 in last 10 games. Accountability take before biggest series of second half.

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Cubs went 1-2 against a 63-71 Reds team.

A 17-5 blowout in Game 2 doesn't cover for it. Rodriguez's 3-run shot in the 4th ended Game 3 early. Burns was sharp. The Cubs weren't.

3-7 in the last 10. Milwaukee's next.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Clay Holmes — Ace Mode Ahead of Biggest Start
stories.angle: Holmes (5-6, 2.26 ERA) is the trade deadline acquisition meeting his moment. Last start vs Arizona: 7 scoreless IP, 2 hits. Tonight faces Brewers (85-52, NL-best). He's the stopper this team needs.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes has a 2.26 ERA since joining the Cubs at the deadline.

His last start: 7 scoreless innings against Arizona. Two hits. Zero runs.

Tonight he faces the team with the best record in baseball. This is exactly why they traded for him.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: September Callups — Wiggins, Baez Incoming Tomorrow
stories.angle: Roster expansion begins September 1 (tomorrow). Wiggins: 4 hitless Iowa relief frames, 7 K in 16 batters, touches 101 mph — Cubs' No. 2 pitching prospect, CubbieCrib calls it "obvious callup." Javier Baez confirmed heading up. BJ Murray (.294/.404/.499 in 451 PA at Triple-A) also in mix.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
September rosters expand tomorrow.

Jaxon Wiggins: 101 mph, 7 strikeouts in 16 batters, four hitless Iowa relief frames. The Cubs' No. 2 pitching prospect is the obvious callup.

Javier Baez is also heading up. The cavalry arrives at the right time.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Standings + Division Math
stories.angle: Cubs 77-60, sharing NL WC1 with Phillies entering September. 7.5 GB in Central with 26 left — long shot but not zero. Seven of next 10 vs Milwaukee. Cardinals 67-68 practically eliminated. Rival jab at Cardinals for energy.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Cubs 77-60. Sharing the NL's top Wild Card with the Phillies entering September.

7.5 back in the Central with 26 left. Seven of the next 10 are against Milwaukee. The math starts tonight.

The Cardinals? 67-68. Practically cooked.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Swanson + Steele Rehab — Both Closing In
stories.angle: Dansby Swanson (Grade 2 oblique, IL since Aug 17) resumed defensive work Aug 28, light swinging starts this week per Counsell. Justin Steele throws live BP Tuesday and Friday in Mesa; MiLB rehab assignment is next. Two October weapons inching toward return.

x_posts.label: Post 6A
x_posts.text:
Dansby Swanson (Grade 2 oblique, IL since Aug 17) resumed defensive work Aug 28. Light swinging starts this week.

Justin Steele throws live BP Tuesday and Friday in Mesa. A MiLB rehab assignment is next.

Both could be October weapons.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #GoCubs

stories.title: Pre-Game Hype — PCA, Holmes, 6:40 PM CT
stories.angle: Set the table for 6:40 PM first pitch. PCA (.281, 35 HR, 31 SB, 7.9 WAR — best in baseball) headlines the lineup. Holmes (2.26 ERA, 7 scoreless last time out) takes the mound. Wrigley at full volume for September stakes.

x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong. .281, 35 HRs, 31 steals, 7.9 WAR — best in baseball.
